evaluation_protocol.held_out_selection_rule: every 5th subject of numeric sort of 1..60 (12/60 = 20%)
evaluation_protocol.held_out_is_test_once: P5 v0.1 actual: test subjects were evaluated once per candidate model, only after model selection on the development set; the strict single-test-on-final-candidate-only discipline is enforced in P5.1
evaluation_protocol.no_snapshot_split: no subject's snapshots appear in more than one fold or in both dev and test
evaluation_protocol.imputation: SimpleImputer(strategy=median) inside each Pipeline, fitted per training fold only
evaluation_protocol.scaling: StandardScaler inside each Pipeline, fitted per training fold only

status_note: P5 v0.1 is a first-round baseline on PoPu public data only. No model is formally frozen; no UNKNOWN/REJECT threshold is set. Candidate freeze and strict once-only held-out test are deferred to P5.1.
known_deviations_from_strict_protocol: held-out test was evaluated once per candidate model (not only on the final candidate) in P5 v0.1
model selection never read any held-out test score; selection was based solely on development-set GroupKFold OOF macro_f1

model_selection.no_test_selection: held-out test is never used to choose a model or tune a threshold
